create_action_bonus_wrapper: create an ActionBonus wrapper to add exploration rewards for less visited state-action pairs in a gym environment
create_state_bonus_wrapper: create a StateBonus wrapper to add exploration rewards based on visited grid positions in a gym environment
create_fully_obs_wrapper: create a FullyObsWrapper to give the agent a fully observable compact grid encoding of the entire environment
create_view_size_wrapper: create a ViewSizeWrapper to customize the agent field of view size for a partially observable gym environment
create_direction_obs_wrapper: create a DirectionObsWrapper to provide slope or angular direction to the goal in observations
